name: revealwhy
description: Ask Claude why your website isn't converting. CRO audits, funnel drop-off, ignored CTAs, attention and content engagement, A/B test verdicts and AI-agent traffic — grounded in real visitor behaviour, with evidence and honest confidence.

api_key.title: RevealWhy API key
api_key.description: Scoped key (starts with rw_) for reading insights. RevealWhy → Settings → Developers → Secret API keys, scopes read:analytics + read:findings; add write:findings to let the agent report fixes. Optional to install RevealWhy into a codebase — that only needs the public publishable key.

project_id.title: RevealWhy project ID
project_id.description: Default project for every tool (RevealWhy → Settings → Tracking code → Project ID). Tools can still take projectId explicitly.
